entities.name: Radio priority
entities.description: An information element that indicates the radio priority level, which may be modified and included in certain network operations.

entities.name: UE supports A/Gb mode
entities.description: Condition that the UE supports A/Gb mode operation.

entities.name: Radio priority is modified
entities.description: Condition that the radio priority value has been changed.

entities.name: Network supports mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode
entities.description: Condition that the network supports mobility procedures from S1 mode to A/Gb mode.

entities.name: Include radio priority IE
entities.description: Network behavior to include the radio priority information element when specified conditions are met.

relations.description: UE support for A/Gb mode is a condition for including the radio priority IE.
Modification of radio priority is a condition for including the radio priority IE.
Network support for S1 to A/Gb mobility is a condition for including the radio priority IE.
The property of including the radio priority IE establishes the presence of the IE in the message.
